1. 1907 draft scheme. Each party pays its own costs and an equal share of the costs of the trial. (art. 29)
2. Five Neutral Powers. Every contesting party shall pay its own costs in each case. (art. 50)
3. Interparliamentary Union. Same as 1907 draft. (art. 15)
4. International Law Union.
5. Denmark. Every contesting party shall pay its own costs in each case. (art. 20)
6. Norway. Same as Denmark. (art. 20)
7. Netherlands. Same as 1907 draft. (art. 52)
8. Sweden. Same as Denmark. (art. 29)
9. Switzerland.
10. Italy.
11. Germany.
12. Austria.
